limitations_and_boundaries: Proof-of-concept limited to three cancer cell lines and 188 compounds.
HDAC inhibitor analysis focused on 17 compounds; two relatively insoluble compounds excluded from TC50-IC50 comparison.

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that 2081 (48%) of the 4308 differentially expressed genes over the HDAC inhibitor trajectory responded in a cell-type-dependent manner.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Of the 4308 genes that were significantly differentially expressed over this consensus trajectory, 2081 (48%) responded in a cell-type–dependent manner and 942 (22%) exhibited the same pattern in all three cell lines

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that the large-scale screen profiled 649,340 single cells across 4992 independently treated cell populations.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: After sequencing and filtering based on hash purity (fig. S4, B to F), we obtained transcriptomes for 649,340 single cells, with median mRNA UMI counts of 1271,1071, and 2407 for A549, K562, and MCF7, respectively

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that the aggregate expression profiles for each cell type were highly concordant between replicate wells (Pearson correlation = 0.99).
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: The aggregate expression profiles for each cell type were highly concordant between replicate wells (Pearson correlation = 0.99) (fig. S5B).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that 7561 genes were sensitive to at least one drug in the pilot experiment with four compounds.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: A total of 7561 genes were sensitive to at least one drug, and 3189 genes were differentially expressed in response to multiple drugs (fig. S3A and table S2).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that the viability score from sci-Plex was concordant with gold standard measurements.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: After fitting a response curve to the recovered cellular counts, we inferred a “viability score” from sci-Plex data, a metric that was concordant with “gold standard” measurements (Fig. 2F and fig. S2, G to I).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that 6238 genes were differentially expressed in a dose-dependent manner in at least one cell line in the large screen.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: In total, 6238 genes were differentially expressed in a dose-dependent manner in at least one cell line (FDR < 5%; fig. S8 and tables S4 and S5).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that sci-Plex dose-dependent effect profiles correlated with compound-matched L1000 measurements.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Moreover, sci-Plex dose-dependent effect profiles correlated with compound-matched L1000 measurements (11) (fig. S10).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that acetate, pyruvate, and citrate supplementation blocked pracinostat-treated cells from reaching the end of the HDAC inhibitor trajectory.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: In both A549 and MCF7 cells, acetate, pyruvate, and citrate supplementation was capable of blocking pracinostat-treated cells from reaching the end of the HDAC inhibitor trajectory (fig. S31, F, J, H, and L).

missed_core_items.description: The extraction omits the key result that HDAC inhibition led to sequestration of acetate in the form of markedly increased acetylated lysine levels.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Accordingly, we observed that HDAC inhibition led to sequestration of acetate in the form of markedly increased acetylated lysine levels after exposure to a 10 μM dose of the HDAC inhibitors pracinostat and abexinostat (fig. S30).

research_questions.statement: Can nuclear hashing enable cost-effective high-throughput chemical screens with single-cell transcriptomic readouts?

provenance.text_excerpt: These results demonstrate that hash oligos stably label nuclei in a manner that is compatible with sci-RNA-seq.

claims.statement: Nuclear hashing with ssDNA oligos stably labels nuclei and is compatible with sci-RNA-seq.

experiments_or_tasks: Barnyard experiment: HEK293T and NIH3T3 cells seeded in 48 wells each, labeled with 96 well-specific polyadenylated ssDNA oligos, fixed, pooled, and subjected to two-level sci-RNA-seq.

methods.name: Nuclear hashing
methods.protocol_description: Nuclei from permeabilized cells are labeled with polyadenylated single-stranded DNA oligos (hash oligos) in a well-specific manner, then fixed with paraformaldehyde, pooled, and processed via sci-RNA-seq.

study_units.name: Nuclear hashing validation
